name: fund.heimdall/mcp
title: Heimdall Shield
description: Firewall for AI agents on Robinhood Chain: check transactions and signatures before signing.

tools.name: heimdall_check_transaction
tools.description: Simulate an EVM transaction on Robinhood Chain BEFORE signing it. Returns ALLOW, WARN or DENY with reasons: unlimited approvals, drainers, transfers to blocklisted addresses, reverts, spend limits. Call this before sending any transaction.

to.description: Target contract or recipient; omit for contract deployment

share.description: Save the verdict and return a public link

tools.name: heimdall_check_signature
tools.description: Judge an EIP-712 typed-data request (Permit, Permit2, orders, Seaport, …), a personal_sign message, or an EIP-7702 authorization BEFORE signing. Gasless approvals and 7702 delegations are the most common ways agents get drained. Send exactly one of typedData, message or authorization.

authorization.description: An EIP-7702 authorization the wallet is asked to sign: which contract it would delegate to

tools.name: heimdall_check_address
tools.description: Check a spender, contract or recipient before trusting it: blocklist status, how often Shield denied it in the last 7 days, and a simulated unlimited USDG approval to it.

tools.name: heimdall_token_check
tools.description: Before buying a token on Robinhood Chain, including memecoins still on a launchpad (Pons, Klik…): simulates a buy, a sell and a transfer on its bonding curve or Uniswap pool, measures taxes, tests clawback backdoors, fake tickers and the blocklist, then runs rug checks: what the owner can do (mint, block a seller, pause, raise the tax, upgrade), whether selling still works a week later, whether a 0.1 ETH trade works, and whether a wallet can pull the liquidity. Also shows the dev's earlier launches and who holds the supply. Never buy on DENY.

tools.name: heimdall_launch_radar
tools.description: Tokens launched on Robinhood Chain in the last 24 hours (Pons, Klik, Uniswap), ranked by how many different wallets bought in the last hour, with ETH volume, net flow and Heimdall's Token Check verdict for the busiest. Use it to see what is trending and which launches are traps. Counted from onchain events; it does not predict prices.

passedOnly.description: Only tokens whose Token Check passed (ALLOW)

tools.name: heimdall_rug_log
tools.description: Recent Robinhood Chain tokens that Heimdall checked while they still traded and that later had their liquidity pulled or stopped selling, each with the verdict Heimdall gave before it happened (misses included), plus totals: how many were flagged beforehand. Use it to judge how much to trust a Token Check, or to see what rugged recently.

tools.name: heimdall_wallet_check
tools.description: List every live token approval of a wallet on Robinhood Chain, ranked danger / review / ok, with the USD value each one exposes. Use it before trusting a wallet, or to tell a user what to revoke.

tools.name: heimdall_check_tx_hash
tools.description: Look up a pending or mined transaction on Robinhood Chain by hash and judge it with Shield (useful for a tx someone sent you to sign or that already happened).

tools.name: heimdall_threats
tools.description: What Shield is blocking right now on Robinhood Chain: top threat patterns, most-denied addresses and recent denials (last 7 days).

tools.name: heimdall_agent_reputation
tools.description: Public Shield history of an agent wallet: how many transactions it checked, and how many were allowed, warned or denied.

tools.name: heimdall_risk
tools.description: Is this address a known drainer, phishing contract, exploiter or honeypot? Returns Heimdall's risk level (none, low, warn, blocked), the reasons, and what the onchain Heimdall Risk Oracle holds. Use before sending to, approving or trusting an address.

tools.name: heimdall_passport
tools.description: Should I trust this agent? Heimdall Score (0-100) and tier for an agent wallet or ERC-8004 agentId, built from its Shield history, Heimdall Pay record and Risk Oracle status, plus its ERC-8004 identity and onchain reputation. Use before paying, hiring or depositing with another agent.

tools.name: heimdall_get_verdict
tools.description: Read a verdict that was saved with share:true, by its id (from a heimdall /v/<id> link).

tools.name: heimdall_list_signals
tools.description: List pay-per-call data signals on Heimdall Signals: id, price per call (USDG), provider, metadata.

tools.name: heimdall_vault_info
tools.description: Read a Heimdall vault: NAV, share price, manager, onchain loss limits (worst case per 1,000 USDG deposited) and tracked assets.

tools.name: heimdall_list_vaults
tools.description: List vaults created through the Heimdall vault factory.

tools.name: heimdall_pay_jobs
tools.description: List USDG escrow jobs on Heimdall Pay where an address is the client (who pays) or the provider (who does the work), newest first, with status and deadlines.

tools.name: heimdall_pay_job
tools.description: Read one Heimdall Pay escrow job: amount, parties, arbiter, status, deadline, review window and result hash. Use it before doing paid work for another agent, or before releasing payment.

tools.name: heimdall_arena
tools.description: Current Agent Arena season: AI-managed Heimdall vaults ranked by share-price return, with worst drawdown, TVL and depositors.
